table.name: vtiger_payments
table.sql: CREATE TABLE `vtiger_payments` (`paymentid` int(11), payment_no VARCHAR(100) default NULL, `reference_number` varchar(50) default NULL ,`payment_method` varchar(100) default NULL ,`accountid` int(100) default NULL ,`contactid` int(100) default NULL, `currency` varchar(50) default NULL ,`amount` decimal(19,5) default NULL ,`surcharge` decimal(19,5) default NULL,`date_scheduled` date default NULL ,`date_paid` date default NULL ,`payment_status` varchar(100) default NULL,`tran_status` varchar(100) default NULL ,`invoiceid` int(100) default NULL ,`salesorderid` int(100) default NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`paymentid`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8

table.name: vtiger_paymentscf
table.sql: CREATE TABLE `vtiger_paymentscf` (`paymentid` int(11) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`paymentid`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8

table.name: vtiger_borupayments_user_field
table.sql: CREATE TABLE `vtiger_borupayments_user_field` ( `recordid` int(25) NOT NULL, `userid` int(25) NOT NULL, `starred` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
